designNotes: Sparse overlays intended for individual scene use. All geometry is native SVG. Spectrum colors appear only in spectrum-stripe.svg. The terminal uses live editable monospace text; font appearance depends on the renderer.

assets.name: Calibration frame
assets.motionUse: Draw corner brackets first, reveal edge ticks, then resolve the center reticle. Use as a short acquisition or focus state around the mascot.

assets.name: Orbital diagram
assets.motionUse: Reveal the three orbital ellipses in sequence. Move each particle along its matching ellipse or rotate the whole orbital system around the shared origin.

assets.name: Topology map
assets.motionUse: Trace links from the root into two lanes and four leaves. Pop the nodes on after each link, then sweep the lime route to introduce a swarm or delegation beat.

assets.name: Oscilloscope trace
assets.motionUse: Use a left-to-right clip reveal or a path stroke draw on signal-trace, with the head tracking the reveal. The signal is decorative geometry, not measured telemetry.

assets.name: Terminal process module
assets.motionUse: Reveal observe, build, and verify on successive beats. Blink terminal-cursor, fade previous lines slightly, and use the window marks as a restrained opening cue.

assets.name: Spectrum stripe
assets.motionUse: Reveal the eight hard-edged segments as a brief spectrum scan or color-state transition. Scale the band height or wipe across it before the mascot rainbow transformation.
